fields.mechanism: EMG-controlled semi-active damping with inertial sensing for adaptive response
fields.intervention: Implement EMG-controlled semi-active damping in shoulder prosthesis with inertial sensing to adapt to different movement patterns and loads
fields.expected_effect: Reduce recurring injuries by allowing the prosthesis to dynamically adjust its damping characteristics based on muscle activity and movement patterns, preventing excessive forces that lead to device failure
fields.falsification_test: Compare traditional shoulder prostheses with EMG-controlled semi-active prostheses in simulated daily activities, measuring forces transmitted to the joint and surrounding tissues, and recording failure rates over 12 months of use
fields.mechanism_source_span: A dual-channel sensing scheme-surface EMG from the rectus femoris and an IMU-drives a five-state gait finite state machine implemented on a low-power STM32H platform

fields.mechanism: Passive structural optimization with topology optimization
fields.intervention: Apply topology optimization (SIMP) to shoulder prosthesis components to minimize weight while preserving stiffness and structural safety without active control elements
fields.expected_effect: Reduce mechanical failures through optimized load distribution while maintaining structural integrity under repetitive loading conditions
fields.falsification_test: Fatigue testing of topology-optimized components versus standard components under cyclic loading simulating 10 years of use
fields.mechanism_source_span: topology optimization (SIMP) to minimize weight while preserving stiffness. Finite-element analyses (critical load 2.94 kN) confirmed structural safety (yield safety factor ≥ 1.6) and favorable fatigue margins

fields.mechanism: EMG-controlled semi-active damping with inertial sensing
fields.intervention: Implement EMG-controlled damping system in shoulder prosthesis using surface EMG from deltoid and an IMU to monitor shoulder movement patterns
fields.expected_effect: Real-time adjustment of prosthetic resistance to match patient's intended movements, reducing stress on implant components during repetitive shoulder motions
fields.falsification_test: Compare implant component wear rates between traditional shoulder prostheses and EMG-controlled versions under simulated repetitive shoulder motion testing
fields.mechanism_source_span: A dual-channel sensing scheme-surface EMG from the rectus femoris and an IMU-drives a five-state gait finite state machine implemented on a low-power STM32H platform.

fields.mechanism: EMG-triggered semi-active damping with inertial sensing
fields.intervention: Integrate surface EMG sensors and inertial measurement unit (IMU) into shoulder prosthesis design to detect muscle activation patterns and joint movement, triggering adaptive damping response
fields.expected_effect: Prevent recurring shoulder instability by providing real-time resistance adjustment during movement, reducing injury events while maintaining natural motion
fields.falsification_test: Compare stability metrics (dislocation frequency, range of motion, patient-reported pain) between traditional shoulder prostheses and EMG-controlled versions across 100 patients over 2 years
fields.mechanism_source_span: A dual-channel sensing scheme-surface EMG from the rectus femoris and an IMU-drives a five-state gait finite state machine implemented on a low-power STM32H platform. The end-to-end EMG→PWM latency remained <200 ms (mean 185 ms). Bench tests reproduced commanded flexion within ±2.2%, with average electrical power of ~4.6 W and battery autonomy of ~5.7 h using a 1650 mAh Li-Po pack.

fields.intervention: Implement EMG-controlled semi-active damping system in shoulder prosthesis to adapt to varying load conditions during arm movement
fields.expected_effect: Reduced stress on prosthetic components during dynamic shoulder movements, preventing component loosening and failure
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated durability testing simulating 5 years of shoulder movement with EMG-controlled damping vs. conventional passive damping, comparing component wear and failure rates
